tone: Use concise, neutral European Spanish and address the user consistently without slang.
capitalization: Use sentence case and Spanish capitalization rules for UI labels.
button_labels: Use short infinitive or imperative actions consistently and omit final periods.
technical_terms: Prefer established Spanish software terminology and preserve glossary tokens.
punctuation: Use Spanish punctuation conventions while keeping placeholders and accelerators intact.
units: Use metric conventions and locale-appropriate decimal formatting when requested by context.
natural_language: Prefer natural European Spanish over literal English word order.
